ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Cancelled"), $Profile.Name <> 'Integration User', NOT(ISPICKVAL($User.UserType, "AutomatedProcess")), OR( NOT($Permission.Invoice_Cancel_Permission), ISBLANK(Remarks__c) ) )
